nodes.description: Address of the TradeSquad NFT contract used for balanceOf fee checks; settable by owner via setTradeSquadAddress.
Payable vault address that receives collected swap fees; settable by owner via setVaultAddress.
Mapping from a dapp address to its custom bridge interface address, used for non-standard token transfers.
Mapping of dapp addresses allowed by the system; enforced before every token transfer loop.
Counters.Counter holding the monotonically increasing swap identifier.
Mapping swapId => array of swapStruct describing assets escrowed by the swap creator.
Mapping swapId => array of swapStruct describing assets expected from the counterparty.
Mapping creator address => array of swapIntent records holding swap state, values, fees and status.
Mapping swapId => index inside the creator's swapList array used to resolve a swap.
paymentStruct with fee enabled flag and fee value applied to swap creations.
Mapping swapId => expected creator address, used for authorization checks.
Mapping swapId => expected counterparty address, editable by the creator and used for authorization.
Owner address stored by the inherited Ownable contract and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Payable external entry point that creates a swap intent, pulls creator assets into escrow, records the intent and emits swapEvent.
Payable external entry point executed by the counterparty that settles both asset sides, moves native value and fees and marks the swap Closed.
External entry point for the creator that rolls back escrowed assets and refunds swap fees and native value, marking the swap Cancelled.
External function letting the swap creator change the expected counterparty address for a swap id.
Owner-restricted function toggling whiteList status for a list of dapp addresses.
Owner-restricted function enabling/disabling the payment fee and setting its value.
Fallback receive function that accepts native ETH and emits paymentReceived.
ERC721 receiver hook invoked by safeTransferFrom when NFTs are sent to this contract.
Caller-supplied address used for authorization, swap ownership and recipient of refunds/transfers.
Miner-influenceable timestamp stored in swapStart/swapEnd and used in event bucketing.
ERC20 transfer/transferFrom, ERC721 safeTransferFrom and ERC1155 safeBatchTransferFrom calls to arbitrary whitelisted dapp contracts.
Native ETH transfers to VAULT, addressOne and addressTwo via transfer().
customInterface.bridgeSafeTransferFrom call to a bridge contract resolved through dappRelations.
Caller-supplied swapIntent struct used to build the escrowed swap in createSwapIntent.
Caller-supplied array of creator asset structs escrowed by createSwapIntent.
Caller-supplied array of counterparty asset structs recorded by createSwapIntent.
Creator address parameter used by closeSwapIntent to locate the swap in swapList.
Swap identifier parameter used to resolve the swap record in closeSwapIntent and cancelSwapIntent.
Loop counter local variable iterating over nftsOne/nftsTwo arrays in createSwapIntent, closeSwapIntent and cancelSwapIntent.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes _swapIntent.addressOne and the escrow owner of the created swap.
msg.sender must equal the recorded counterparty and becomes addressTwo/recipient in closeSwapIntent.
msg.sender must equal checksCreator and the stored addressOne to cancel a swap.
msg.sender must match checksCreator and addressOne to edit the counterparty.
onlyOwner restricts setWhitelist based on comparison of owner() with msg.sender.
onlyOwner restricts setPayment based on comparison of owner() with msg.sender.
block.timestamp is stored into _swapIntent.swapStart and used in the emitted event bucketing.
block.timestamp is written into swapEnd and used to bucket the emitted swapEvent.
block.timestamp is written into swapEnd and used to bucket the emitted swapEvent.
The caller-provided swapIntent struct supplies addressTwo, valueOne and the swap parameters.
_nftsOne entries are pushed into nftsOne and drive the escrow transfer loop.
_nftsTwo entries are pushed into nftsTwo and stored for later settlement.
_swapCreator indexes swapList to resolve the swap being closed.
_swapId resolves swapMatch, checksCounterparty and the nftsOne/nftsTwo arrays.
_swapId resolves swapMatch and the escrowed asset arrays during cancellation.
createSwapIntent loops over creator assets and calls external token transfer functions.
createSwapIntent calls the dapp custom bridge for non-standard assets.
closeSwapIntent performs multiple external token transfers while swap state is being updated.
closeSwapIntent sends native ETH to VAULT, addressTwo and addressOne via transfer().
closeSwapIntent calls the dapp custom bridge during settlement.
cancelSwapIntent returns escrowed tokens through external transfer calls.
cancelSwapIntent refunds the creator with native ETH via transfer().
cancelSwapIntent calls the dapp custom bridge to roll back non-standard assets.
Native ETH transfers can re-enter the contract through receive() if the recipient executes a fallback.
ERC721 safeTransferFrom to this contract invokes the onERC721Received hook.
Custom bridge transfers of NFTs can invoke the onERC721Received hook on this contract.

normalization_plan.reason: The _swapIntent parameter only carries caller data into createSwapIntent.
The _nftsOne parameter is only consumed as escrow input by createSwapIntent.
The _nftsTwo parameter is only consumed and stored by createSwapIntent.
The _swapCreator parameter is only used to locate the swap inside closeSwapIntent.
The _swapId parameter is only used as a swap lookup key by closeSwapIntent and cancelSwapIntent.
The loop index i is a transient counter local to the createSwapIntent transfer loop.
